body:
> It also look like what golang community is doing (file.go, file\_test.go). Maybe we could directly take this road which is even better IMHO.

I generally don't put them too close because otherwise it's not clear where to put fixture/resource files that are used by tests (you clearly don't want to add them next to sources). Having the `__tests__` directory is OK if that's the "default/common" convention for React, the naming is just super weird -> it really looks like something auto-generated or that you shouldn't modify :/
